title: Make prominence visible -- QSS rules for hero/quiet (the profiles currently render identically)
change: BUG, VERIFIED AT THE SEAT: all three profiles look identical. compositor._apply_spec sets widget.setProperty('prominence', ...) and repolishes correctly, and the manifests declare hero/quiet on the right widgets (curious: connect+corpus hero, token_meter+palette_hint quiet; ml: token_pill and rail meter hero), but NO QSS rule anywhere selects on that property, so the repolish repaints identically. Fix it in the stylesheet only -- do not touch the compositor, the manifests, or synapse_panel.py; the Python half is already correct. DERIVE, DO NOT INVENT: python/synapse/panel/designsystem/tokens.py is the source of truth and already carries the emphasis ladder this needs -- TEXT_BRIGHT (emphasis/headings), TEXT_PRIMARY (body), TEXT_TERTIARY (captions/hints), TEXT_DISABLED, SIGNAL (accent), RAISED (raised/hover surface), HAIR (quietest rule). In python/synapse/panel/designsystem/qss.py add attribute-selector rules for [prominence="hero"] and [prominence="quiet"] alongside the existing interaction-state rules, following the construction of the rules already in that file. Standard prominence must remain EXACTLY as it renders today -- expert is pinned to v5.42.0 by L5-5 and every widget there is standard, so any change to standard breaks that pin. Derive hero as a step UP the existing ladder (e.g. text moves toward TEXT_BRIGHT, optionally a RAISED surface or SIGNAL accent where the widget already supports one) and quiet as a step DOWN it (toward TEXT_TERTIARY). Change emphasis only: no size changes, no font swaps, no layout shifts, no new colours -- the difference must be legible at a glance without moving anything. Record the derivation in docs/PROFILES.md under the existing 'Design gaps for human decision' section heading, rewritten to 'Derived design decisions', as one line in the form 'X derived from Y because Z'. Add tests/test_rope_prominence_visible.py: assert the generated stylesheet contains a rule selecting prominence=hero and one selecting prominence=quiet, and that the two rules are not byte-identical to each other.

accept.note: SEAT: restart panel, switch CURIOUS/EXPERT/ML -- Connect+Corpus visibly lift on Curious, TOKEN lifts on ML, Expert unchanged
